engine.description: Scan Target baselines plus finalized subdomain facts for open network ports and report host-port findings.

naabu_active.description: Actively probe target-scoped hosts for open TCP ports using naabu.
naabu_active.name: Naabu Active

port-mode.description: Port selection mode: top scans selected top ports, custom scans only explicit ports, and top-and-custom scans top ports plus explicit ports when provided. The previous top-plus-custom value is no longer accepted.

ports.description: Explicit ports or ranges mapped to -p when port-mode is custom, or added in top-and-custom when non-empty.

threads.description: Number of concurrent naabu workers mapped to -c.

timeout.description: Runtime timeout in seconds for the active naabu process.

top-ports.description: Naabu top ports preset mapped to -top-ports when port-mode is top or top-and-custom; allowed values are 100, 1000, and full.

naabu_passive.description: Collect passive port intelligence for target-scoped hosts using naabu.
naabu_passive.name: Naabu Passive

timeout.description: Runtime timeout in seconds for the passive naabu process.
